Good pet advice should make things clearer, not scarier.

I’m Dr Carra — a veterinarian, practice owner and final-year MSc Animal Nutrition student. This channel helps pet owners make sense of the health, nutrition and behaviour questions that become confusing online, with practical, evidence-led answers and honest context.

You’ll find focused videos on the questions that matter at home: what to notice, what to ask, and what may help. You’ll also find The Paws & Effect Podcast — longer conversations with veterinarians, researchers, behaviourists, welfare experts and others working to improve animal care.

Pet care is rarely black and white. The aim is not to offer easy answers or unnecessary fear, but to help you understand the context, ask better questions and make informed decisions for the animals you love.

Subscribe for useful answers, real conversations and a clearer way through pet health information.
